memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark... He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark. When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! - Gen 8:9-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The first time the dove went out, it found no place to rest and came back empty. Noah had to wait seven more days. But the second time, the dove returned in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in its beak - a small green sign that life was returning to the earth. What a moment of hope that must have been! Somewhere out there, trees were growing again. The judgement was passing, and new life was springing up.

That tiny olive leaf carried an enormous message. It told Noah that God's promise was coming true, that beyond the waters of judgement there was a renewed world waiting. Sometimes God gives us small signs like this - little tokens of hope that remind us He is still at work, that the season is turning, that new life is on the way.

The olive branch has become a symbol of peace ever since, and rightly so. After the storm of God's judgement came the leaf of new life and peace. It points forward to the true and lasting peace God brings after judgement - the peace we have with God through Jesus Christ (Rom 5:1), and the new creation He is bringing.

Whatever flood you are passing through, watch for the olive leaves - the small mercies and quiet signs that God is bringing you into a new season. He is a God who brings life after the flood, and peace after the storm.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Where might God be giving you small signs of hope right now?
- Do you have peace with God through Christ after the storm of judgement?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: God of hope, thank You for the small signs of new life You send after the storm. Help me watch for Your olive leaves, and thank You for the lasting peace I have with You through Jesus.
